A '''vanguard armor regiment''' or '''heavy armor regiment''' was a formation of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]].

==Organization==
A vanguard armor regiment was comprised of three [[armor battalion]]s, a [[repulsorlift battalion]], and a [[regimental headquarters]]. A vanguard armor regiment's strength was 2,483 personnel supported by 262 [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]].<ref name="ISB" />

The regiments could be augmented by the addition of four more armor battalion.<ref name="ISB2" />
